statement: Catalog/significance status can be described as stable or sensitive to the audited release revision within the frozen public-data rules.
Some candidate support is demonstrably multi-pipeline, single-pipeline, or unresolved in the public result surface.
GWOSC aggregate/surface representation can compress pipeline-level disagreement or best-pipeline identity.

Downstream analyses that condition on a catalog cohort may structurally inherit release-version dependence.
Any pipeline is scientifically superior or yields the true candidate set.
Catalog-absent candidates are noise or catalog-present candidates are certainly astrophysical.

p_astro is a pipeline-independent objective probability.
